extracted.name: Vanilla cake
extracted.description: Here’s the recipe for eggless vanilla cake which I absolutely love. You can bake vanilla cake in a oven or in a pressure cooker.
instruction_lines: Take the butter and condensed milk in a big bowl
Take a hand blender and whisk it properly until the mixture turns white
Now add all-purpose flour, baking soda, salt and vanilla extract.
Now add warm milk and mix well to make it a consistent batter.
Transfer the batter in a round cake tray and level it up.
Now bake the cake in a preheated oven at 180 degree Celsius for 25 mins
Now check the middle of the cake with a toothpick or knife tip, if it comes out clean then the cake is baked properly if not then bake for another 10 mins.
Let it cool and then enjoy eggless vanilla cake.
